prompt: Create one complete, realistic, isolated painting as a regular household product. Visible geometry and style: 横版长方形，细木框加白边衬纸; 复古风景油画风. Use materials ['木质画框', '油画布'] and colors ['棕色', '米白色', '暖橘色']. Preserve ['细木框加白边的样式', '暖调风景画面']. Regularize temporary disorder with ['摆正画框位置']. Simplify modeling complexity with ['简化画面细碎笔触']: use clean broad surfaces, shallow orderly folds, separated non-intersecting parts, and avoid tangled fabric or dense tiny wrinkles. Complete occluded, back, side and underside regions using {'type': 'bilateral', 'completionRule': '保持画框四边对称均匀'} and ['补全完整画框结构']. Texture rule: 油画笔触肌理; 延续风景画面的柔和色调笔触. Target plausible real-world dimensions are approximately 0.70 m wide, 0.06 m deep and 0.60 m high. Preserve the corresponding width-to-depth-to-height proportions. These are category-prior estimates rather than pixel measurements. Use conservative category structure, repeated modules, continuous closed geometry, and one 45-degree product view on a plain light background. Keep only the main object.
